product.name: Chocolate Cake
product.description: Indulge in a slice of pure bliss with our Decadent Dark Chocolate Dream Cake. This is more than just a cake; it's a rich, luxurious experience designed for the ultimate chocolate lover.

product.name: Blueberry Cheesecake
product.description: Savor the exquisite balance of creamy decadence and bright, fruity notes with our Heavenly Blueberry Cheesecake. It's the perfect dessert for those who appreciate classic richness elevated by a burst of fresh flavor.

product.name: Zesty Lemon Raspberry Delight
product.description: A bright and airy dessert featuring layers of moist lemon sponge cake infused with fresh zest. Filled with a tangy raspberry curd and frosted with a delicate, tart lemon cream cheese icing. It's sunshine in every slice!

product.name: Classic Strawberry Shortcake
product.description: A timeless favorite featuring tender vanilla shortcake layers, filled with fresh, sliced strawberries macerated in their own syrup. Generously blanketed in light, sweetened whipped cream. Simple, fresh, and irresistible.

product.name: Butter/Shortened Cake
product.description: A dense, moist cake made with a creaming method (butter and sugar are creamed together). Includes white, yellow, and chocolate cakes.

product.name: Carrot Cake
product.description: A moist, dense cake made with shredded carrots, warm spices (like cinnamon and nutmeg), and usually oil (instead of butter) to keep it moist. Often includes nuts or raisins and is topped with cream cheese frosting.

product.name: Pandesal
product.description: The national breakfast bread. A soft, slightly sweet/salty roll dusted with breadcrumbs. Best eaten warm.

product.name: Ensaymada
product.description: A sweet, soft, coiled brioche-like roll topped with butter, sugar, and grated cheese.

product.name: Monay
product.description: A dense, heavy, and slightly sweet bread with a characteristic split down the middle. Often used for sandwiches.

product.name: Pan de Coco
product.description: Soft, sweet rolls filled with a sweet, moist grated coconut filling.

product.name: Spanish Bread
product.description: A soft, rolled bread filled with a sweet, buttery mixture of sugar and breadcrumbs.

product.name: Pan de Regla
product.description: A long, sweet bread with a bright red, sweet filling made from mashed day-old bread and sugar.

product.name: Mamon
product.description: A small, light, and airy sponge cake (Filipino chiffon) that is soft and slightly sweet, often brushed with butter and sugar.

product.name: Puto
product.description: A steamed rice cake, typically made with rice flour, sugar, and milk. It has a soft, spongy texture and is often topped with cheese or a slice of salted egg.

product.name: Bibingka
product.description: A traditional baked rice cake, often made with coconut milk and sugar, and typically cooked in a terracotta oven lined with banana leaves. It's a holiday favorite.

product.name: Buko Pie
product.description: A popular type of custard pie filled with creamy custard and tender young coconut meat (buko). It has a flaky crust and is a specialty of Laguna province.

product.name: Ube Crinkles
product.description: Soft, chewy cookies with a beautiful purple hue and a sweet, earthy flavor from Ube (purple yam), dusted with powdered sugar.

product.name: The Chocolate Chip (Mo' Cookies)
product.description: A large, thick, gooey, and chunky chocolate chip cookie. Often sold as "palm-sized."
